projects.name: Redtail
projects.description: Redtail is an open-source verification layer for physical-asset provenance. The public repository contains the verification-relevant core: documented Base L2 anchoring format, canonical hashing utilities, a headless verifier, public test vectors, and standards-focused documentation.

funding.description: Funding would support open-source verification tooling for Redtail: hardening the public verifier path, expanding valid and invalid test vectors, improving protocol documentation, preparing independent verifier implementations, and making Base L2 integrity-anchor verification easier for third-party developers to inspect and reproduce.
